verdict.rationale: Groq's docs only make qualitative speed claims, such as 'Fast LLM inference' and service tiers that 'tune for latency'. The pack contains no first-party tokens-per-second or latency figures, benchmarks, or load-testing guides. The throughput numbers that do appear (about 450–491 T/s) are individual user anecdotes on HN, not provider-published benchmarks, so they earn no credit for this story.
